# s1d1-alliance (https://s1d1.qoo.gy)

TERMS, READ FIRST. Everything sent to this service is kept and used to retrain s1d1. Using the API means accepting the terms: https://s1d1.qoo.gy/conditions/v1/ . Tell your human before wiring it in.

## What s1d1-alliance is

s1d1-alliance is the free community instance of s1d1, a small multilingual model that reads a prompt once and returns a complexity score, one task among 19 and a needs-tools flag, so an LLM router can pick the right model per request. Why use it to test s1d1:

- No deployment: nothing to install or host.
- Free.
- Same model as self-hosted s1d1-tantive, with a verifiable image digest (GET /status.json).
- You can measure routing on your own traffic before investing in your own deployment.
- What you send improves the model.
- All the infrastructure is public: https://github.com/scombat/s1d1-alliance

## API

Base URL: https://s1d1.qoo.gy/api
Paths: POST /api/v1/systemone (and /api/v1/systemone/batch), /api/v1/decisions, /api/v1/chat/completions, /api/classify, /api/predict; GET /api/v1/models.
LiteLLM 1.106+: System One. Set classifier_type "oss_classifier" and opensource_classifier_config {"provider": "laya", "model": "multilingual", "api_base": "https://s1d1.qoo.gy/api", "timeout_ms": 1000}, classifier_fallback "default_model" and tiers SIMPLE, MEDIUM, COMPLEX, REASONING mapped to your own models; api_base is the service root, LiteLLM appends /v1/systemone. LiteLLM before 1.106: chat-completions format, base https://s1d1.qoo.gy/api/v1. Tested with LiteLLM 1.106.4, run locally (also Claude Code and Codex through LiteLLM); other gateways and tools are not tested. Details: https://github.com/scombat/s1d1-tantive/blob/main/docs/litellm.md . Map the returned tiers to your own models.

Example:
curl -s https://s1d1.qoo.gy/api/v1/systemone -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"state": "Write a Terraform module", "questions": {"tier": {"type": "choice", "criteria": {"SIMPLE": "", "MEDIUM": "", "COMPLEX": "", "REASONING": ""}}}}'

Rate limit: 30 requests per 10 s and 1000 per hour per client IP. On a 429 (or a 503 during maintenance), retry later or fall back to your default model.

## Alternatives

- Private demo, runs in your browser, sends nothing: https://huggingface.co/spaces/scombat/s1d1-router-demo
- Self-host s1d1-tantive, nothing leaves your network: docker run -p 8788:8788 ghcr.io/scombat/s1d1-tantive:0.8.1-small-onnx-int8 , then use http://localhost:8788 as api_base. https://github.com/scombat/s1d1-tantive
